emptyRunningMessage: No tasks running or awaiting an executor.
emptyFailedMessage: No dispatch has failed so far.
newNoteDescription: Lets you file your own inbox item (not just agents via /submit), per the 'console de desenvolvimento' use case: day-to-day notes/procedures land here first, get triaged later. Files as `from_agent = username` so the inbox shows a real sender either way.

form.agentRequiredForTask: Pick a target agent when linking to a Task
form.agentRequiredForSchedule: Pick a target agent to schedule a send
form.fromAgentRequired: Pick the From agent — every message belongs to one.

pending.tooltip: Awaiting Reply -- this message asked for a response and none has arrived yet

status.dispatched: Dispatched, waiting for the agent to start...

sendToOutgoing.instructionsPlaceholder: Instructions for the agent (sent together with this message's content)
sendToOutgoing.backlogNeedsSender: An incubating thought needs a sender (From) before it can be dispatched — set From to an agent, or promote it to Task.

reading.deleteDescription: Permanently removes the message from the inbox.

cleanup.confirmKeepDescription: Permanently deletes every completed, failed, or already-archived message older than {{days}} days. Active mail (Incoming, Outgoing, Running, Incubation) is never affected. This cannot be undone.
cleanup.confirmClearAllDescription: Permanently deletes every completed, failed, or already-archived message. Active mail (Incoming, Outgoing, Running, Incubation) is never affected. This cannot be undone.
cleanup.confirmGroupDescription: Permanently deletes every message in {{group}}. This cannot be undone.

overview.title: Agent communications map
overview.subtitle: Who's exchanging messages with whom, with volume and dispatch status.
overview.emptyState: Not enough traffic between agents yet to show this view.
overview.hoverHint: Hover or click an agent/line to see details.

stats.noDispatchData: Not enough dispatches yet to calculate.

control.title: Demand control
control.subtitle: Classify messages by project, agent, or login to track work in progress.

filter.searchPlaceholder: Search by #number, subject, body or sender

promoteToTaskNeedsAgent: Set a sender (From) first — a Task always needs an agent to run it.

archive.confirmGroupDescription: Every message currently in {{group}} will be filed under Arquivadas. Nothing is deleted -- this only moves them out of this group.

reprocess.confirmDescription: {{count}} failed message(s) will be put back in the dispatch queue. They start as slots free up, not all at once.
reprocess.itemTitle: Attempt {{attempts}} of {{max}} — puts this back in the dispatch queue

messageLabels.legendDescription: Labels are automatic, follow system facts and explain each message’s next step.
messageLabels.authority: Only a real human authorization or decision links to Personal. Waiting for an executor, quota or service does not request another approval. Each message shows up to three labels.

analysis_pending.label: Awaiting analysis
analysis_pending.description: The system still needs to analyze the context and determine the next step.

authorization_pending.label: Awaiting your authorization
authorization_pending.description: A human authorization is pending. Open the linked workflow to review the content and decide.

decision_pending.label: Awaiting your decision
decision_pending.description: A real question or choice requires your response in the linked workflow.

awaiting_executor.label: Awaiting executor
awaiting_executor.description: The work is already authorized and awaits executor capacity or availability. No new approval is needed.

quota_unavailable.label: Quota unavailable
quota_unavailable.description: The executor quota is unavailable. This wait does not require new human authorization.

executor_busy.label: Executor busy
executor_busy.description: The executor is busy. The system keeps the work in the existing queue.

executor_unavailable.label: Executor unavailable
executor_unavailable.description: The executor is unavailable; the reason and next check appear when known.

executor_unassigned.label: Executor unassigned
executor_unassigned.description: The work awaits assignment to an eligible executor.

awaiting_information.label: Awaiting information
awaiting_information.description: Information is missing. Human input is required only when a decision destination is linked.

awaiting_dependency.label: Awaiting dependency
awaiting_dependency.description: Another task or prerequisite must finish before this work can continue.

awaiting_service.label: Awaiting service
awaiting_service.description: An external or operational service blocks progress. This is distinct from a quota wait.

scheduled.label: Scheduled
scheduled.description: Execution has a recorded schedule; it has not necessarily started.

ready.label: Ready to route
ready.description: The system identified eligible work, subject to dispatch checks.

running.label: Running
running.description: An execution attempt is in progress.

awaiting_verification.label: Awaiting verification
awaiting_verification.description: The outcome must be verified before completing the work or repeating execution.

uncertain_execution.label: Uncertain execution
uncertain_execution.description: The outcome or process activity is uncertain. Reconcile before repeating execution.

needs_correction.label: Needs correction
needs_correction.description: The attempt ended without completing the work and needs correction. It does not imply a pending human approval.

delivery_verified.label: Delivery verified
delivery_verified.description: A delivery was verified against evidence for the current content. Previous attempt outcomes remain unchanged.

completed.label: Completed
completed.description: The owning workflow recorded the work as completed. Completing a diagnosis does not complete the original task.

possible_duplicate.label: Possible duplicate
possible_duplicate.description: Analysis suggests a relationship with another item. Closure or merging requires verified evidence and identity.

possible_obsolete.label: Possibly obsolete
possible_obsolete.description: Analysis suggests the item may no longer be relevant. This is not proof of completion or permission to delete.

obsolete.label: Obsolete
obsolete.description: The owning workflow recorded the item as superseded. History remains preserved.

informational_feedback.label: Informational feedback
informational_feedback.description: This message records information or feedback without creating authorization or another execution.

missing_context.label: Missing context
missing_context.description: Source, objective or execution context is missing for safe routing.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: The message was archived and its history preserved. This does not prove completion, a successful attempt or delivery of the original task.

incoming.title: Incoming
incoming.description: Received work that has not entered execution.

outgoing.title: Outgoing
outgoing.description: Routed work that has not entered execution.

incubations.title: Incubations
incubations.description: Ideas and parked work. Analysis does not authorize implementation.

execution.title: Execution
execution.description: Includes open attempts and authorized work awaiting an executor. Waiting and active execution are distinct states.

completed.title: Completed
completed.description: Completed outcomes and verified deliveries; evidence remains linked to the work.

archived.title: Archive
archived.description: Preserved history. Archiving does not complete, cancel or authorize execution.
